name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width, lower it to your mid-chest, then press back up to full arm extension.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Same as the flat bench press but on an incline bench (30-45°) to shift emphasis to the upper chest and front shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, press them up until your arms are extended, then lower with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Same as the dumbbell bench press but on an incline bench, pressing the dumbbells up and slightly together at the top.

name: Push Up
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up without letting your hips sag or pike.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lying on a flat bench with a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, then bring them back together over your chest.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Standing between two cable towers with handles at chest height, bring your hands together in front of you in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in the elbows.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles at chest height, press forward until your arms are extended, then return with control.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight, lean forward slightly, lower until your shoulders are below your elbows, then press back up.

name: Pull Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar, then lower back to a full hang.

name: Chin Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip, pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar, then lower back to a full hang.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms fully extended and shoulders relaxed, holding the position for time to build grip and shoulder stability.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs secured under the pad, grip the bar wider than shoulder-width, pull it down to your upper chest, then let it rise back with control.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and slight knee bend, pull the bar to your lower ribs, then lower it back down without rounding your back.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: One knee and hand supported on a bench, pull the dumbbell up to your hip with the opposite hand, keeping your torso still, then lower with control.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with knees slightly bent, grip the handle, pull it to your torso while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then extend back out.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit with chest against the pad, pull the handles toward you while squeezing your shoulder blades, then extend your arms back out.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down to grip it just outside your legs, then drive through your heels to stand up tall, keeping the bar close to your body throughout.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes turned out, grip the bar inside your knees, then drive through your heels to stand up, keeping your chest up and back flat.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar across your upper back, hinge forward at the hips with a soft knee bend and flat back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then return to standing.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell in each hand at your sides and walk for distance or time, keeping your shoulders back and core braced.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Standing, grip a high cable bar with straight arms, pull it down to your thighs using your lats, then let it rise back with control.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold a bar in front of your thighs, shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears, then lower with control — no rolling or curling.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears, then lower with control.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Bar at shoulder height, press it straight overhead until your arms are locked out, then lower back to the shoulders without arching your lower back.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Dumbbells at shoulder height, press them straight overhead until your arms are extended, then lower back with control.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad, press the handles straight up until your arms are extended, then lower back with control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, raise your arms out to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, then lower with control.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Grip a low cable handle across your body, raise your arm out to shoulder height, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, raise one or both arms straight out in front to shoulder height, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinged forward at the hips with a flat back, raise the dumbbells out to the sides squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Grip a rope attachment at head height, pull it toward your face while flaring your elbows out and squeezing your shoulder blades together.

name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions: Grip the bar just inside shoulder-width, pull it straight up along your body to chest height leading with your elbows, then lower with control.

name: Wall Arm Raise
instructions: Stand or sit with your back flat against a wall, slide your arms up overhead and back down while keeping contact with the wall to build shoulder mobility and control.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding the bar with an underhand grip, curl it up toward your shoulders keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, curl them up toward your shoulders keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, then lower with control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other, curl them up keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, then lower with control.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Grip the angled bar at the inner handles, curl it up toward your shoulders keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, then lower with control.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Arms braced against the preacher pad, curl the weight up toward your shoulders, then lower it fully to stretch the biceps.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with arms hanging straight down, curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, then lower with control.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand holding a low cable bar or handle, curl it up toward your shoulders keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, then lower with control.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Grip a high cable bar or rope, push it down until your arms are fully extended keeping your elbows pinned to your sides, then let it rise back with control.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Facing away from a low cable, grip the rope behind your head and extend your arms overhead, then return with control.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, lower it behind your head by bending at the elbows, then extend back up.

name: EZ Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lying on a bench holding the bar above your chest, bend your elbows to lower it toward your forehead, then extend back up.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with hands just inside shoulder-width, lower the bar to your chest keeping your elbows tucked, then press back up.

name: Triceps Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or a bench with arms straight, lower until your elbows reach about 90°, then press back up, keeping your torso upright to emphasize triceps.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearm resting on your thigh or a bench with palm up, curl the dumbbell up using just your wrist, then lower with control.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms and toes on the floor, body in a straight line from head to heels, brace your core and hold the position without letting your hips sag or rise.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl your shoulders up off the floor toward your knees, then lower with control.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneeling in front of a high cable with a rope attachment, crunch your torso down toward your knees using your abs, then return with control.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar, raise your legs up toward your chest keeping them straight or slightly bent, then lower with control without swinging.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with your torso leaned back and feet lifted or planted, rotate a weight from side to side across your body.

name: Cable Woodchopper
instructions: Grip a high (or low) cable with both hands, rotate your torso to pull it diagonally across your body to the opposite hip, then return with control.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Hips on the pad of a back extension bench with legs secured, lower your torso down, then raise back up to a straight line without hyperextending.

name: Superman
instructions: Lying face down with arms extended overhead, simultaneously raise your arms, chest, and legs off the floor, hold briefly, then lower with control.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lying on your side propped up on one forearm, lift your hips so your body forms a straight line, and hold the position while keeping your hips square.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: On hands and knees, extend one arm and the opposite leg out straight while keeping your back flat, then return and switch sides.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lying on your back with arms up and knees bent at 90°, lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor while keeping your lower back pressed down, then switch sides.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart, squat down until your hips drop below your knees, then drive back up through your heels.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Bar racked across the front of your shoulders, squat down keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest, squat down between your legs, then drive back up through your heels.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower the weight by bending your knees toward your chest, then press back up without locking out your knees.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Holding a dumbbell in each hand, step forward into a lunge, lower your back knee toward the floor, then push off to step forward into the next lunge.

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: Bar across your upper back, step forward into a lunge, lower your back knee toward the floor, then push back to standing and repeat on the other leg.

name: Bodyweight Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, lower your back knee toward the floor, then push back to standing and repeat on the other leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on a bench behind you, lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front leg, then drive back up through your front heel.

name: Machine Leg Extension
instructions: Sit with the pad resting on your shins, extend your legs until straight, then lower back down with control.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Holding the bar at hip level, hinge back at the hips with a slight knee bend until you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit with the pad against the back of your ankles, curl your legs down and back, then return with control.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lying face down with the pad against the back of your ankles, curl your legs up toward your glutes, then lower with control.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back braced on a bench with the bar across your hips, drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, then lower with control.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent and feet flat, drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes, then lower with control.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Ankle strap attached to a low cable, kick one leg straight back and up while keeping your torso stable, then return with control.

name: Machine Hip Adductor
instructions: Sit with the pads against the inside of your knees, squeeze your legs together against the resistance, then return with control.

name: Machine Hip Abductor
instructions: Sit with the pads against the outside of your knees, push your legs apart against the resistance, then return with control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Holding a dumbbell in each hand, rise up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heels back down with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with dumbbells resting on your knees, rise up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heels back down with control.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at the hips to swing the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward explosively to swing it up to chest height.

name: Air Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, squat down until your hips drop below your knees keeping your chest up, then drive back up through your heels.

name: Deep Squat
instructions: Feet slightly wider than shoulder-width with toes turned out, squat down as low as comfortable while keeping your heels planted, and hold or pulse to build hip and ankle mobility.

name: Cossack Squat (Kazak Squat)
instructions: Wide stance, shift your weight to one side and bend that knee to lower into a deep side squat while keeping the other leg straight, then push back to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Single Leg Rear Deadlift
instructions: Standing on one leg with a slight knee bend, hinge forward at the hips while extending the other leg straight back, then return to standing.

name: Kneeling Hip Drive
instructions: Kneeling on one knee with the other foot planted in front, drive your hips forward and up by squeezing the glute of the kneeling leg.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
instructions: Sit with both knees bent at 90° — one in front, one to the side — then rotate through your hips to switch the position of your legs to the opposite side.

name: Single Knee Fallout
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent and feet flat, let one knee fall out to the side while keeping your pelvis still, then return and repeat.

name: Double Knee Fallout
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent and feet together, let both knees fall out to the sides together, then return with control.

name: Mini Happy Baby
instructions: Lying on your back, grab the outsides of your feet or shins and gently pull your knees toward your armpits to open the hips.

name: Frog Stretch
instructions: On hands and knees, widen your knees out to the sides and rock your hips back toward your heels to stretch the inner thighs.

name: Bodyweight Neck Curl
instructions: Lying on your back, gently nod your chin toward your chest to curl your neck up off the floor, then lower with control.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Run at a steady pace or interval on the treadmill, keeping an upright posture and a natural stride.

name: Stationary Bike Ride
instructions: Pedal at a steady pace or interval on the stationary bike, keeping a slight bend in your knee at full extension.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive through your legs, lean back slightly, then pull the handle to your ribs, reversing the sequence — arms, then torso, then legs — on the way back.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Curl + Upright Row
instructions: Curl the kettlebell up with an overhand grip, then continue pulling it up along your body to chest height leading with your elbows, before reversing back down.

name: Kettlebell Curl + Halo
instructions: Curl the kettlebell up to your shoulders, then circle it around your head in one direction, before curling back down.

name: Kettlebell Curl + Press
instructions: Curl the kettlebell up to your shoulder, then press it straight overhead, before reversing back down.

name: Kettlebell Curl + Pullover
instructions: Curl the kettlebell up to your shoulders, then lower it back and overhead in a pullover arc while lying or standing, before reversing back down.

name: Close-Grip Kettlebell Push-Up
instructions: Hands close together gripping the kettlebell handle (or placed close together on the floor), lower your chest down, then press back up.
